services.desc: Laguna Madre Anglers offers Corpus Christi Fishing trips for the Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, and Land Cut. Please see our Guided Sight Seeing Tours, Sunset Cruise, and Dolphin Watch page for other trips available. We look forward to taking you fishing in the Laguna Madre, Land Cut, and/or Baffin Bay for a rewarding fishing experience. Your catch will be cleaned and bagged for you to take home, so please bring your cooler.
